summary.en: Read and send iMessage and SMS in the Messages app
summary.zh: 讀取、傳送「訊息」App 裡的 iMessage 和簡訊

text.en: Not yet: no local server for Messages that ShellBot can recommend. The ones that exist are each kept by one person, and those that can send have no switch to stop it.
text.zh: 還不能接：還沒有 ShellBot 能推薦的「訊息」本機伺服器。現有的都只有一個人在維護，能傳訊息的那些也沒有辦法關掉傳送。

next.en: ShellBot will add a way once there is one it can stand behind; nothing needs doing now.
next.zh: 等有 ShellBot 信得過的接法就會加上；現在不用做什麼。
